questions.history: Inspect slot 1 and read the child values at all indices in its reported half-open interval.
questions.prediction: The parent returns end 2 for start 3 even though the object contains [40,50]. The merge should return [3,5) and child readback [40,50], equal to the object.
questions.basis: A view of length two beginning at index three ends at five. Issue #470 and the regression identify the old size-as-end behavior.
questions.refutation: End precedes start, end minus start differs from two, or the child slice disagrees with the object.

questions.history: On the merge compare slot 1 with a slot in a separate vector whose child is [40,50] and whose valid view starts at zero with size two. Compare their objects and `hashCode(slot)` values using the default hasher.
questions.prediction: Equal ordered element values should yield equal slot hashes regardless of their physical position. On the parent the nonzero-offset loop can visit no elements. No particular numeric hash is required.
questions.basis: Both slots denote the same typed sequence. Relocating the physical slice while preserving its contents tests the consumer that hashes the view.
questions.refutation: The objects compare equal but the hashes differ depending on the child offset.
